summary: Defines the SIP Pending Additions event package. SIP relays use it to tell user agents about the consent-related status of entries that are to be added to a resource list. It is a standards-track document that works with the SIP consent framework.

eli5.summary: When you invite people to a group, some have not yet said yes. This lets the relay tell you who is still waiting for permission to join.

questions: consent status of resource list entries
